supporting_evidence.summary: significant deviations in scope [all services]: currencyservice_mem z=43.35 (216.8%); currencyservice_socket z=20.75 (103.7%); productcatalogservice_cpu z=-3.35 (-28.4%); frontend_socket z=3.03 (15.1%)
traces for currencyservice: SIGNIFICANT change; own spans self-time p50 0.1->0.09ms (0.9x), errors 0.0->0.0; inbound calls self-time p50 66.8->293.96ms (4.4x), errors 0.0->0.0

alternatives_rejected.why: frontend_socket z=3.03 is minor next to currencyservice_mem z=43.35 and currencyservice_socket z=20.75 (E1). It fits frontend waiting on slow currencyservice calls, whose inbound p50 went 66.8->293.96ms (E2).
Its CPU fell (z=-3.35, -28.4%) rather than rose (E1), which points to reduced load, not CPU saturation.
The socket deviation (z=20.75) is about half the memory deviation (z=43.35) in E1. The socket rise most likely follows from memory pressure stalling connections.

proposed_fix.description: Restart or roll the currencyservice pods to reclaim memory and raise or enforce container memory limits. Then profile currencyservice for a memory leak and fix it in code. Watch whether inbound latency returns to its baseline of about 67ms p50.
